visual_elements.description: Left panel: rounded rectangle, white fill, green (~#009933) border ~3px. Contains an illustration of an AC motor: gray body with cooling fins, horizontal output shaft with flange/mounting plate on the right, darker gray terminal box on top with a dark cable curving up-left. Label 'AC Motor' in black sits to the upper right of the motor. A tan rounded rectangle (~1.5in x 0.9in) overlaps the motor's lower-left, containing 'Sin/Cos Encoder' in dark maroon text on two lines.
Solid red block arrow (Right Arrow shape) pointing right, indicating signal flow from the encoder to the output-signal caption.

Right panel: large rounded rectangle, white fill, green (~#009933) border ~3px. Inside is a circular waveform diagram: two sinusoidal traces wound around a common circle — one red and one green, interleaved so red crests alternate with green troughs — with 16 oscillation periods around 360 degrees. A small white circle with gray outline sits at the center (encoder shaft). Two black dashed radial lines run from the center circle toward the right (about 2-3 o'clock), spanning one signal period; a black curved arrow between their outer ends is labeled 'Sin/Cos signal period'. At the top inside the ring, a black curved double-headed arrow sits above the text 'Rotation direction', with 'CCW/CW' below it. Outside the ring at upper right, 'cos' in red has a thin leader line pointing to the red trace, and 'sin' in green has a leader line pointing to the green trace. Below the center: bold black 'Line count =16' and beneath it '(16 signal periods per revolution)'.
Slide-number badge: circle with pale yellow fill, dark maroon/brown outline, containing the number '25' in dark text.
Thin red rectangular frame (outline only) inset from the slide edges, enclosing all content; solid black horizontal bar across the very bottom of the slide.

No numbered or bulleted lists on the slide.
